title: Kimodo-Policy: Learning Kinematic Action Models for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

release_status.value: Official training, sim evaluation and real-world collection/deployment code; model checkpoints, data and evaluation artifacts linked; not executed.

evidence_boundaries: Star denotes additional 419h robot-interaction policy pretraining; both variants retain a pretrained Kimodo backbone
Paper SIMPLE scores differ from current fixed README for Push Office Chair (100 versus 80 percent)
Paper states 25–30 real demonstrations per task; release lists 236 total and 24–38 per task
Baselines partly compiled from different reports, not a unified reevaluation
SIMPLE paper advantage over Psi0 is one success in 240 trials
Real experiments use task-specific policies and ten trials per task
Ablation Figure 14 reports three HOI tasks, not overall seven-task success
Single-task Arena average is lower after interaction pretraining
RTC active only in real experiments; its contribution not isolated
Kinematic references require SONIC; no general cross-tracker validation
Code/checkpoints/data release verified by documentation, not reproduced
